name: GPU Instancing with Texture Buffer Objects
definition: A technique to render many instances of a single mesh (like voxels) by storing instance-specific data (position, scale) in a Texture Buffer Object (TBO) and reading it in a vertex shader, sending base mesh data only once.
summary: GPU Instancing with Texture Buffer Objects renders many identical primitives by storing instance attributes in a TBO, distinguishing itself by leveraging texture memory hierarchy for caching and compatibility.
